texts.zh: 在暴力和苦难中，这个文明在一位领袖的领导下走向了统一。通过压制较弱的派系来巩固权力，他们现在成为了科学和技术进步的坚定倡导者。在这之后，是一段不稳定的和平的时期。但和平终究是一种短暂的状态。
texts.en: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.

texts.zh:
[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]结束了我们的内斗，带来了大一统。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]在一个爱国团结的帝国中上独掌大权，允诺带领我们去到繁星间，并创建一个伟大的星际帝国。

今天，我们的人民已经失去了耐心，异见的声音正在拷问我们的领袖是否有能力胜任。内阁准备了一个三十年的计划来让他们息声，并带领我们的物种走向一个新的时代。
texts.en:
[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] put an end to our internal strife and brought about the Unification. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] came to power on a platform of patriotic unity and imperialism, promising to lead us into the stars and create a grand galactic empire.

Today, our people grow impatient, and dissident voices question our leadership abilities. The council has prepared several 40-year plans that will put these doubts to rest, and propel us into the next age of our species.

texts.zh:
新的殖民地是履行[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]允诺的第一步。

殖民船被永久地转化成了新定居点的行政中心。我们正如火如荼地将其反应堆核心连接进电网，为殖民地发展提供能源。

随着无数的殖民者从船上登陆，围绕着殖民船巨大的船体，各种简易搭盖的住所和棚户如雨后春笋般出现。以这些建筑作为基础，有朝一日此地将会成为[Root.GetName]上的第一座[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]城市。
texts.en:
This new colony is the first step towards fulfilling the [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]'s promise.

The colony ship has been permanently converted into the administrative headquarters of the new settlement. Work has begun to connect its reactor core to the power grid to supply the growing colony with energy.

As colonists disembark in large numbers, makeshift dwellings and shelters have been erected around the former starship's massive hull. These will form the basis of what will one day be the first [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] city on [Root.GetName].

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]告诉[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]应当放下旧的疑虑，展望未来。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]指出了我们共同取得的伟大成就，并指出让我们的过去错误阻碍我们前进是极其不合理的。如果[Root.Owner.GetName]能够团结一致，就没有什么是我们无法克服的！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] tells the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] to cast aside old doubts and look to the future. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] points to the great things we have achieved together, and to the irrationality in allowing our past mistakes to hold us back from progress. If the [Root.Owner.GetName] stand together as one, there is nothing we cannot overcome!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

在接下来的信息中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]在[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]面前赞扬了某些特定个人的成就——包括[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis]自己的成就。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap]接着列举了我们共同取得的伟大成功，从一次光荣的成功到下一次，构筑起一个更加美好的未来。

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

In the message that follows, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] regales the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] with praise and stories on select individuals' accomplishments - including [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHerHis] own. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHeCap] goes on to list what we have achieved together, one glorious success after the other, building up to a promise of an even greater future.

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
在[Root.GetName]上新建的城市是一道靓丽的风景线。凭借奋斗与决心，殖民者成功地在新星球发展兴旺。

[Root.GetName]上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]决定建造一座纪念[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的纪念碑以彰显忠诚。
texts.en:
The new cities built on [Root.GetName] are a sight to behold. Through grit and determination, the colonists have managed to thrive on a new world.

[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] citizens on [Root.GetName] decided to show their loyalty by erecting a monument to honor [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName].

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕被打断了播放安排，开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的殖民者想赞扬我，但今天，我想感谢你们每一位的辛勤劳动。[Root.Owner.GetName]万岁！
texts.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wished to honor me, and I thank them. Glory to the [Root.Owner.GetName]!

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但今天，我们应为在一起奋斗过感到光荣，让我们携手步入成功！
texts.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. With my guidance, with your hard work, no obstacle shall stand in our way! The colonists of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me, but today, all are honored equally. United we triumph!

[Root.Owner.GetName]每一块国有的屏幕突然中断了正常的播放，然后开始广播一段来自[Root.GetName]的官方公告。画面中，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]站立在一座未揭幕的纪念碑前。

今日，我们创造了历史，我们的物种过去从未达成过此般成就。在我的带领和你们辛勤的工作下，没有任何事物可以阻挡我们！[Root.GetName]上的居民想以此赞扬我，但他们才是我们人民真正的英雄。我只不过是一介人民公仆，有了你们，我们才能迈入光明的未来。
texts.en:
Every state-owned screen in the [Root.Owner.GetName] interrupts its scheduled stream to broadcast an official communication from [Root.GetName]. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] stands in front of a veiled monument.

Today, we have made history. Never before has our species realized a grander achievement. The people of [Root.GetName] wanted to honor me today, but they are the real heroes of our people. I am but a servant of our nation. Thanks to you, we take another step towards a brighter future!

texts.zh:
内阁已经不堪重负。

尽管[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的能量似乎无穷无尽，但治理一个星际帝国的工作量已使内阁成员们超负荷工作。尽管如此，仍然有一些问题尚未解决，有必要将一部分担子分出去，让其他人处理。
texts.en:
The council is overwhelmed.

While [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s energy seems unlimited, the councilors are overworked by the demands of a galactic empire. Issues have been left unresolved, and it will be necessary to pick up some of the slack.

texts.zh: 我们收到了许多关于海盗袭扰我们贸易路线的报道。内阁正在请求军事支援来应对这些威胁。
texts.en: We have received multiple reports of pirates plaguing our trade routes. The council has asked for military support to deal with this menace.

texts.zh: 一些殖民者和深空研究团队对我们的通讯系统颇有微词，他们已经有好几天收不到消息了。工程师建议在首都建造一座通讯中继器来增强信号。
texts.en: Some colonists and deep space research teams are criticizing our communication systems - there are days when they can't get any message through. Engineers suggest building a communication relay in our capital system to boost the signal.

texts.zh:
信号增强器已经激活。初步测试证明，它足以确保在我们的太空中进行稳定通信。

现在看来，之前的干扰是有意为之的破坏行为。虽然破坏者的身份仍未知晓，但新系统应该能够保护我们免受任何进一步的干扰。
texts.en:
The signal booster has been activated. The first tests prove that it should be enough to ensure stable communication across our space.

It now appears that the previous disruptions were caused by intentional acts of sabotage. While the perpetrators remain unknown, the new system should protect us against any further disruption.

label.zh: 我们夺回了自己的声音。

texts.zh: 深空工人正在罢工，抗议严峻的工作环境。他们要求增加休息时间并提升工作安全管理。作为回应，我们提议给予他们数天全休日，并在首都星球举行一场盛大游行，重新点燃他们的民族自豪感。
texts.en: Deep-space workers are striking in protest against harsh conditions. They demand more free time and increased safety regulations. In response, we have proposed a slate of work-free days and a grand parade on our capital world to reignite a sense of national pride.

texts.zh: 游行进行得比我们的预想好得多！公民们为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]欢呼喝彩的画面被拍下来，并在[Owner.GetName]范围内广为流传，以对恩慈的[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]表示尊敬。不过，在首都还是爆发过一些小规模的骚乱，但秩序很快就恢复了，没有伤亡发生。媒体也因安保单位的快速反应而对[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]大加赞扬。
texts.en: The parade went better than expected! Images of citizens cheering for [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] were recorded and published across [Owner.GetName] to show support for the benevolent [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]. While a number of small riots were reported across the capital, order was swiftly restored. There were no casualties, and state media praised [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] for the swift response of our security forces.

texts.zh: 我们收到了一些关于基层军官诋毁[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]名声的报告。这样的行径绝不能逃避惩罚。那些相关者，最少最少，也应该被开除军籍。
texts.en: There have been reports of low-ranking military officers actively smearing the name of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]. This cannot go unpunished. Those responsible should, at the very least, be discharged from the service.

texts.zh: 这些谋反的异见军官被逮捕了。庆幸的是，他们的人数很少，但这次事件表明，即使是我们的军队也可能被叛徒渗透。我们抓住了主要的煽动者，但我们不应该排除与非军事组织的联系。
texts.en: The dissident officers who were conspiring against us have been arrested. Thankfully, they were few in numbers, but this incident indicates that even our military can be infiltrated by traitors. We were able to catch the main instigators, but we shouldn't rule out possible ties to non-military groups.

texts.zh: 内阁最近受到了严格审查。匿名投诉反映，数目惊人的重要职位被高官的亲朋好友占据。我们已答应调查此事，并改弦易辙。
texts.en: The council has recently come under heavy scrutiny. Anonymous complaints highlight the staggering amount of important positions which have been filled by the friends and family of high-ranking officials. We have promised to look into the matter and to do better.

label.en: We need to clean up our ranks.

texts.zh: 特别委员会对内阁高层进行了彻底的巡查。发现了许多资质不足的人，绝大多数人被解除职务。其中一小部分有前途的人才被送去参加培训。
texts.en: A special committee has scoured the higher echelons of the council. Many unqualified individuals were identified, and most have already been dismissed from their posts. A few of the more promising talents were sent to training sessions.

texts.zh:
尽管[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]已经倍加努力，但仍有许多事务有待完成。整个帝国是由许多互相矛盾的派系组成，人们是在[owner.Ruler.GetTitle]不断的努力下才团结起来。

尽管[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]未曾想过要改革大一统后形成的政府，但一种新的、更直接的体制可以解决其中一些问题。另一方面，这样的决定可能会激起反对意见。
texts.en:
Despite [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s work, there is still much to be done. The empire consists of conflicting factions, and the population is united only through the constant effort of the [owner.Ruler.GetTitle].

Although [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] did not wish to change the post-Unification government, a new, more direct approach could remedy some of these problems. On the other hand, such a decision may encounter significant opposition.

texts.zh:
消息如野火般蔓延开。几位官员签署同意之后，一场盛大的登基仪式在全国范围内进行播报。大多数[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]都为[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]能够完全地掌握国家而感到欢欣鼓舞。

在这一片欢腾的场景之下，掩藏着不可明说的问题和各类不确定情况。新的帝国将会是什么样的呢？
texts.en:
The news spread like wildfire. A few official signatures later, and a grand coronation ceremony was broadcast to the nation. The majority of [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are happy that [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] will now have full control of state.

While the mood is festive, unspoken questions and uncertainties remain. What will this new empire look like?

label.en: The military must play a central role.

label.zh: 法律与秩序是至高无上的。

label.en: Our nation is open to all.

label.zh: 和平将为我们带来繁荣。
label.en: Peace will bring us wealth and prosperity.
Progress will lead us to greatness.

label.zh: 帝国将会成抵御外星威胁的铜墙铁壁。
label.en: The Empire will be a shield against the xeno threat.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]的讯息强调了今天是一个光荣的日子！这个联邦的建立确实是一件值得庆祝的事情。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap]谈到了我们与盟国们构筑的纽带，阐明同[your_ally.GetName]的合使两国迈入全新的时代。一个充满伟大和繁荣的黄金时代！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]'s message highlights what a glorious day this is! The founding of this Federation is truly a cause for celebration. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetHeSheCap] speaks to bonds we forge with our allies, stating that cooperation with the [your_ally.GetName] will usher in a new age. A golden age of greatness and prosperity!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

宣言的重点放在了[your_ally.GetName]，该国承认了我们的优越性，服从我们的统治和指导！该国的明智和信任将得到应有的回报，我们希望其他国家也能做出正确的选择，向我国臣服。

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

The announcement is focused on the [your_ally.GetName], who have recognized our superiority and submitted to our rule and guidance! Their wisdom and trust will be duly rewarded, and we hope that other nations will also make the right choice and submit.

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

前方传来签署和平条约的新闻，同时人们又听说我们的敌人被迫接受巨大的让步，因此欢欣鼓舞。我们见证了在光耀者的指引下获得的胜利！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

The people rejoice as news arrives of a signed peace treaty and the vast concessions our foes were forced to accept. We stand witness to the triumpth of Luminary guidance!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

今天对于[Owner.GetName]来说是一个悲惨的日子。侵略者的残忍行径在新闻推送中得到了充分的展示，[Ruler.GetName]强调在这个黑暗时期团结一致是尤其必要的。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]郑重承诺，确保实现可能的最好结果，同时此类事情不再发生。

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Today is a grim day for the [Owner.GetName]. The brutality of the invaders is on full display in the news feed, as [Ruler.GetName] underlines the necessity of working together during these dark times. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] makes a solemn vow to ensure the best possible outcome, and to never let this happen again.

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]保持沉默。新闻中显示[Owner.GetName]签署了附庸条约。尽管我们始终相信光耀者的统治，但是这一刻无疑是我们文明一个不可避免的挫折。

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] is silent. The newsfeed shows the signing of [Owner.GetName]'s contract of vassalization. Despite our trust in the Luminary's rule, this moment signifies an undeniable setback for our civilization.

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

今天是一个命运攸关的日子。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]自豪地宣布，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe]带来了一个消息：星海共同体已经选举我们成为至高无上的星海监管人。他们承认只有我们才有能力确保这个星系的安全。我们被赋予了巨大的权力，我们的职责不仅仅是履行各国的期许，更是要将其超越。

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Today is a fateful day. [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] stands proudly as [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetSheHe] the news is delivered: the Galactic Community has elected us to supreme Custodianship. They have recognized that we alone are poised to ensure the safety of this galaxy. We have been granted great power, and it is our duty to not only meet, but surpass all expectations.

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

今天是我们胜利的日子！星海参议院任命[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]为星海帝国的皇帝。为了表示敬意，[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName]发誓要把已知的星系及其人民带入一个新的繁荣时代——从现在开始，直到永远！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Today is the day of our triumph! The Galactic Senate has appointed [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] Emperor of the Galactic Imperium. In salute, [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetName] swears to usher the known galaxy and its peoples into a new age of prosperity - from now, and to eternity!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
我们的意识形态反对者已经形成了一个强大的政治集团。他们呼吁他们的支持者聚集在一起，和平抗议他们认为由[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]所颁布的单边变革！

他们认为，我们已经偏离了大一统后设立下的路线，并呼吁[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]废除某些改革。
texts.en:
Our ideological opponents have formed a powerful political block. They have called upon their supporters to gather in peaceful protest against what they see as unilateral changes enacted by [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]

They argue that we have strayed from the path set after the Unification, and call upon [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] to repeal certain reforms.

texts.zh: 一群自称“被遗忘者”的地下团体控诉[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的暴政。他们宣称我国政府从未真正代表人民的意愿，反而只是代表一小撮特定的群体利益。他们并不相信[Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]，并提供了曾经的不同政见者已经失踪的证据。他们这些反复发出的讯息开始在我们的公民群体中埋下怀疑的种子。
texts.en: A secretive group calling themselves The Forgotten has accused [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] of tyranny. They claim that our government no longer represents the will of our people, only the interests of a select few. Their trust in [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has waned, and they have brought forward evidence of dissenters who have suddenly disappeared after criticizing our regime. Their repeated messages are starting to sow doubt in the minds of our citizens.

texts.zh:
在研究了所谓证据后，似乎[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]确实是向那些被遗忘者们撒谎了，至少也是隐瞒了真相。[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]与数个强大的利益派系签订了几份协议，在其中许诺了诸多[Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe]实际上做不到的事情。

今天，被遗忘者代表那些被[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]所欺骗之人的声音，向我们呼吁将政府权力转移至议会及人民手中。
texts.en:
After reviewing the evidence, it appears that [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has indeed lied or at least concealed the truth to the council and the population at large. [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] has signed several contracts with various powerful stakeholders, promising many things that [Owner.Ruler.GetHeShe] could not realistically deliver upon.

Today, the Forgotten have made themselves the voice of all those who have been tricked by the [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] and are calling upon our government to transfer power back to the council and the people.

texts.zh: 一些能够抹黑[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]秘密文件从一个匿名团体处流出。这一叛国行径为这场政治风波火上浇油。被遗忘者最有动机，但却表现得很无辜，因为我们完全找不到他们涉及此事的证据。
texts.en: In an attempt to smear [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s reputation, secret documents have been leaked by an anonymous party. This treasonous act has poured oil onto the political fires that were already threatening to consume our government. The Forgotten, although prime suspects, appear innocent, as we could not find any proof of their involvement.

texts.zh: 政治局势已经失控。煽动者正在煽风点火，而[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的拒绝让步引发了帝国范围内的暴力抗议浪潮。随着伤亡人数的增多，[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]别无选择，只能下令要求以一切必要手段镇压反对派。
texts.en: The political situation has escalated out of control. As agitators fan the flames of revolution, [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s refusal to back down has ignited an empire wide wave of violent protests. The casualties are mounting, and left with no other choice, the [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] has ordered the opposition be crushed by any means necessary.

texts.zh: 在极大的压力下，[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]已经发展出了一种独特的应对压力的方法。尽管有些人可能认为这只是一个怪癖，但它影响着整个内阁。
texts.en: Under intense pressure, [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has developed a unique way to cope with stress. Although some might see this as a simple quirk, it affects the whole council.

label.en: We'll learn to live with it.

texts.zh: [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]通过孜孜不倦地学习以成为一名更好的领袖。[Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap]焕然一新的献身做派让内阁瞩目。
texts.en: [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has worked extremely hard to become a better leader. [Owner.Ruler.GetHisHerCap] renewed commitment has already been noticed by the council.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

在冲突时期，我们很容易忘记为之奋斗的目标，把我们的政治对手视为彻头彻尾的敌人。我们经历了艰难的时刻，但今天我很自豪地告诉你们，我们已经达成了和平的结果。你们的声音已经被听到了。你们曾经信任过我，而我却让你们失望了。

这样的情况到此为止！随着即将到来的宪法改革，我坚信我们已经回到了正确的道路上。出于你们对我能力的信任，我将谦卑地见证这些变革的落实。我发誓，我不会再让你们失望！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

In times of conflict, it can be easy to lose sight of what we fight for, to view our political opponents as outright enemies. We have gone through trying times, but today I am proud to tell you that we have reached a peaceful outcome. Your voices have been heard. You had put your trust in me and I had failed you.

No more! With the upcoming constitutional reform, I firmly believe that we find ourselves back on the right path, and I am humbled by your trust in my ability to see these changes through. Upon my word, I shall not fail you again!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

社会正在螺旋坠入失控境地。猖獗的暴力、隐秘的煽动、无耻的谎言……这些问题困扰我们已久。我自豪地宣布，这些困难时期已经结束！那些试图破坏我们的人已被逮捕，我保证，他们将面临全面的法律制裁。不久之后，他们将为对你们造成的伤害而忏悔！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Society is spiralling out of control. Rampant violence, insidious agitation, shameless lies... These things have plagued us for too long. With great pride, I announce an end to these troubled times! Those who sought to undermine us have been arrested, and I promise, they will face the full force of justice. Before long, they will repent for the harm they caused you!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

今天是伟大的胜利之日，但这并非没有牺牲的代价。我们的敌人已经被消灭，但是他们的背叛使我的心处于巨大的伤痛之中。他们出于自私的目的，试图毁灭我们所有人，但最终，他们无法匹敌我们团结一致产生的力量。很快，他们将因自己的罪行受处决。我们取得了胜利！

传输结束，恢复正常的新闻推送。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Today marks a great victory, but it has not been bought without sacrifice. Our enemies have been destroyed, yet the sting of their betrayal makes my heart bleed. In their selfishness they sought to destroy us all, but in the end, they were no match for our collective strength. Soon they will be executed for their crimes. We have prevailed!

The transmission ends and usual newsfeed resumes.

label.zh: 我们需要一位更强大的领袖！

texts.zh: [Owner.GetHeirTitle][Owner.GetHeirName]去世了。我们尚未确定死因，但初步调查显示这是自然死亡。[Ruler.GetRegnalName]深受[Ruler.GetHisHer]子嗣之丧的打击。官方法令宣布了全国哀悼期，同时我们等待对继承人死因的调查结果。
texts.en: [Owner.GetHeirTitle] [Owner.GetHeirName] is dead. We have yet to determine the cause of death, but preliminary reports suggest natural causes. [Ruler.GetRegnalName] was struck hard by the loss of [Ruler.GetHisHer] progeny. A period of national mourning has been decreed and we await the full results of the investigation into the cause of the heir's death.

texts.zh:
尽管所有的证据都表明这是一次自然死亡，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]却拒绝接受这个事实。[Ruler.GetHisHer]的继承人之死对[Ruler.GetHimHer]产生了很大影响，并下令在我们的领土范围内展开搜捕行动。必须要找到那些为此负责的懦弱的刺杀者。安全部队已经开展行动，根除异见分子。

这些逮捕行动所伴随的暴力程度已经震惊了许多公民。抗议活动再次爆发，谴责滥用权力并要求新一轮政府改革。一个行星的绝大多数人口起来反对[Ruler.GetTitle]的统治，这在我们的历史上属于首次。
texts.en:
Despite every evidence pointing at a natural death, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] refused to accept it. The death of [Ruler.GetHisHer] heir has greatly affected [Ruler.GetHimHer], and orders have been sent across our territories. Those responsible for this cowardly assassination must be found. Security forces are already conducting sweeps to root out dissenters.

The level of violence that has accompanied these arrests has shocked many of our citizens. Protests denouncing the abuses of power and demanding a new wave of government reforms have erupted once again. For the first time in our history, the majority of a planet's population has risen up against the rule of the [Ruler.GetTitle].

texts.zh: [Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]死后，改革派的支持率逐渐降低了。该团体的代表抛开意识形态上的分歧，特意参加了葬礼仪式。虽然今天被悲伤的气氛所笼罩，但也是一个令人团结一心的时刻——提醒[Root.Owner.GetName]所代表的意义。
texts.en: After [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s death, support for the Reformists dwindled. Putting aside their ideological differences, representatives from the group made a point of attending the funeral ceremony. Although today is marred by sorrow, it is also a moment of unity - a reminder of what the [Root.Owner.GetName] stands for.

texts.zh: 无论是我们对资源的巧妙利用还是引入了强有力的惩罚措施，叛乱的星球不再是一个问题。我们再次团结起来，民众专注于发展而不是内讧。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]颁布法令，将今天定为一个特殊的纪念日。
texts.en: Whether due to our clever use of resources or the introduction of robust punishments, rebellious planets are no longer an issue. Once again we stand united, with the populace focused on growth rather than infighting. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has decreed today will be a special commemorative holiday going forward.

texts.zh: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]发现我们的一位领袖正在反对政府！妥善的程序是直接处死这名叛徒，但是证据不是很充分。
texts.en: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has discovered that one of our leaders is plotting against the government! The proper course would be to execute the traitor, but evidence is scarce.

texts.zh: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]下令在我们的一颗行星上进行大范围的清洗行动。显然，那里存在一个改革派据点，但我们尚未掌握充分证据。我们确定要因为预感将忠诚公民的性命置于危险之中吗？
texts.en: [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] ordered a large scale cleansing on one of our planets. Apparently, there is a supposed Reformist holdout there, but no firm evidence has been produced. Will we really risk the lives of loyal citizens on a hunch?

texts.zh: 来自[event_target:friendly_nation]的一位显赫公民希望在我们的内部斗争中帮助我们。他们不仅带来了美好愿景，同时还伴随着一批合金作为援助。似乎他们寻求改善我们之间的关系，但[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]怀疑这是为异己分子的运动建立供应线的诡计。
texts.en: A prominent citizen from [event_target:friendly_nation] wishes to help us in our internal struggle. Their best wishes were accompanied by a shipment of alloys to aid us. It seems they seek to improve relations between us, but [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] suspects a ruse to establish supply lines for the dissident movements.

texts.zh: 改革派的一个小团体加入了当地的海盗组织。虽然他们不是一个严重的威胁，但他们仍然可以扰乱我们在该星域的运营和贸易。
texts.en: One of the alleged Reformist cells joined forces with a local group of pirates. Although they are not a serious threat, they can still disrupt our operations and trade in the sector.

texts.zh: 我们的安全部门成功追踪并捣毁了一个改革派窝点。这次行动取得了极大的成功，人员损失降到最低，没有平民伤亡。
texts.en: Our security service managed to hunt down and dismantle one of the Reformists' cells. The operation was a clear success, with minimal loss of life and no civilian casualties.

texts.zh: 我们的安全部门成功地追踪到了一个改革派窝点，但他们在整个街区都埋设了爆炸物。当我们的特工突入窝点的时候，他们引爆了炸药，杀死了许多人。
texts.en: Our security service managed to track down a Reformist cell, but they had rigged the whole block with explosives. As our operatives breached the lair, they activated the charges, killing many.

texts.zh: 我们和改革派发生了激烈的交火，有很多平民受伤。我们派出了应急部队来照料伤者。
texts.en: Many civilians were hurt in a series of fierce firefights between our forces and the Reformists. We have sent emergency responders to take care of the wounded.

texts.zh: 我们忠诚的支持者举行了一场集会，声援[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]！我们在这场斗争中显然赢得了人民的支持！
texts.en: Our loyal supporters made a rally to back up [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]! We clearly have the support of the people in our fight!

texts.zh: 改革派的宣传部门在我们的某颗行星上发起了一场虚假信息运动。忠诚派势力正在保持高度警戒，意图控制局面，但抗议者的队伍继续壮大。
texts.en: Reformist propagandists led a disinformation campaign on one of our planets. Loyalist forces are on their toes to keep the situation under control, but the protesters continue to grow in strength.

texts.zh: 由于内阁的努力工作，改革派领袖已被迅速逮捕。他们现在听由[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]发落。但另一方面，他们在民众中拥有许多支持者，所以明智的做法是通过谈判达成一个的双方都有利的结果——当然条件是我们说的算。
texts.en: Thanks to the Council's hard work, the Reformist leaders have been swiftly apprehended. They are now at the mercy of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName], but they have many supporters among the populace, and it is advisable to negotiate an outcome that suits both parties - albeit on our terms.

label.zh: 让我们听听他们的条件。

texts.zh: 经过几个月的冲突，现在是时候让我们解决分歧，讨论如何结束这场荒谬的叛乱了。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]已呼吁停火并与改革派进行谈判。所有敌对行动已经停止，每个人都在等待谈判结果的出现。
texts.en: After months of conflict, the time has come to resolve our differences and talk about how we can end this ridiculous revolt. [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has called for a ceasefire to negotiate with the Reformists. All hostilities have ceased, as everyone awaits the outcome of the negotiations.

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]出现在了帝国的每一块屏幕上。我们的人民正在等待演讲开始。

[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞！今天，我想让大家知道，我充满了自豪。我们求同存异，作为一个民族，向着未知一同进发，建造了新的星球，我们的聪明才智达到了新的高度。

我要感谢诸位的付出……

我还要……

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]突然一个踉跄，消失在了画面之外。
texts.en:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] has appeared on every screen across the empire. Our population is waiting for the address to begin.

Fellow [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Today, I want you to know I am filled with pride. As a people, we have come together and, despite differences, ventured into the unknown, built new worlds, and reached new heights of ingenuity.

I want to acknowledge your sacrifice...

I want...

[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] suddenly staggers out of view.

texts.zh:
新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]正生命垂危。这场神秘的急病原因尚不明确，似乎也不会很快结束。

至少目前，[Ruler.GetRegnalName]仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的寿命，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
texts.en:
The news didn't take long to spread among the population; [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] is dying. While the cause of this mysterious illness remains unknown, it does not appear to be immediately terminal.

For now, [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to extend our leader's life by any significant amount of time.

texts.zh:
新闻很快就传遍了全国上下：[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的神经网络出故障了。这个神秘的故障让我们最聪明的人都摸不着头脑，似乎不会很快被排除。

至少目前，[Ruler.GetRegnalName]仍名义上在位。然而，如果想要显著延长我们领袖的工作周期，可能必须依靠一些非传统方法了。
texts.en:
The news didn't take long to spread among the population; [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] neural net is failing. While the cause of this mysterious error has eluded our best minds, it is not immediately terminal.

For now, [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can remain at their post. However, unorthodox methods will be necessary to repair and extend our leader's functionality by any significant amount of time.

label.zh: 一定会有我们行得通的办法的。
label.en: There must be something we can do.

texts.zh:
是时候让[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]再度执掌国家的大舵了。[Ruler.GetName]受赐福继承了光耀者的品质，仍然充满着庄严。然而，随着改革派势力的增强，一场全面内战逐渐逼近，[Ruler.GetTitle]发出了谈判的号召。

[Ruler.GetName]报告道，谈判前期气氛十分紧张。来自[Owner.GetName]各处的代表在听取我们[Ruler.GetTitle]的官方声明——其中列出了所有我们可能接受的让步——之前，纷纷提出了自己的要求。
texts.en:
It is time for [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] to retake the helm of state. Blessed with the heritage of the Luminary, [Ruler.GetName] remains a magnetic figure. However, with the increasing power of the Reformists and a full-fledged civil war looming on the horizon, the [Ruler.GetTitle] issued a call to negotiations.

[Ruler.GetName] reports that early negotiations have been tense. Representatives from all corners of [Owner.GetName] made their demands before listening to our [Ruler.GetTitle]'s official statement, which listed the concessions we might accept.

label.en: We will give them what they want.

label.zh: 我们不会作出任何让步。
轻信这些谈判是他们太愚蠢了。
label.en: They're foolish to trust in these negotiations.

label.zh: 够了！我们的领袖让我们失望了！
label.en: Enough! Our leader has failed us!

label.zh: 我们应该统治星系，单独统治！
label.en: We should rule the galaxy, alone!

texts.zh: 我们成功挣脱了锁链！所有压迫者和暴君都已被推翻。我们可能是引发这场战争的火花，但我们所做的一切都是为了人民的利益。我们必将战胜一切！
texts.en: Our chains are broken! All oppressors and tyrants have been cast down. We may have been the spark that lit this war, but everything we do is for the good of the people. We shall overcome!

label.zh: 我们为了捍卫自己的道路而战！
label.en: We fight to preserve our ways!

label.zh: 我们为了探寻新的道路而战！
label.en: We fight to change our ways!

texts.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将革命的火花带到星空。
texts.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of revolution to the stars.

label.zh: 我们要重建被摧毁的一切。
label.en: We shall rebuild what was destroyed.

label.zh: 我们必须保卫自己的社会！
label.en: We need to safeguard our society!
The civil war has hardened us.

label.zh: 我们必须优先发展和平与繁荣。
label.en: We must prioritize peace and prosperity.

label.zh: 自这样的灾难中，我们必会成长。
label.en: From the devastation, we will grow.

texts.zh: 在谈判前夕，各方显然厌倦了战火，愿意促成协议。我们不知道这将产生什么样的长期后果，但现在我们团结起来了。
texts.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties were sick of warring and would rather strike a deal. We cannot know what long-term consequences this will have, but for now we are united.

texts.zh: 在谈判前夕，局势已经很明显，各方都无法达成一致。即使现在，叛乱实力也正在集结，战争爆发了。再一次我们的国家处于分裂的状态。
texts.en: On the eve of the negotiations, it became clear that the parties would never come to an agreement. Even now, rebel forces are massing, and war has been declared. Once more our nation stands divided.

texts.zh: 号召谈判是一个捕获改革派领袖的完美陷阱。他们聚集在一个地方，收网有如探囊取物。我们不费吹灰之力就获得了有关他们藏身之处、下线和资产的信息。剩下的反对派也轻松地处理掉了，不需要任何让步，也没有发生代价高昂的内战。所有改革派都被[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的法令判处死刑。
texts.en: The call to negotiations was a perfect trap for the Reformist leaders. Gathered in one place, they were easily apprehended. We wasted no time extracting information about their hideouts, followers, and assets. The remaining opposition was swiftly dealt with, without concessions or a costly civil war. Every Reformist has been sentenced to death by decree of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName].

label.zh: 我们现在不能回头了。只能继续。
label.en: We can't turn back now. Proceed.

texts.zh: 随着内乱的余烬逐渐地消失，一个新的社会正从灰烬中崛起，准备将[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的智慧火花带到星空。
texts.en: As the embers of civil strife fade away, a new society is rising from the ashes, ready to carry the spark of [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s wisdom to the stars.

label.en: One country, one Luminary, one future.

texts.zh:
这些年来，得益于天赋异禀的科学家们，我们创造了无与伦比的繁荣和稳定。为了寻找新的途径殖民并发展星球，他们谋划了一些目前被认为是不可能做到的事情——基于目前在异种生物学领域的理解：他们将我们本土的动植物植入到外星环境，并通过大规模的地质改造来改变这颗星球，使其变得宜居。

尽管我们现在不太可能复制这一成功，毕竟这颗被改造的星球有一定特殊性，但这表明，随着时间的推移，我们可以逐渐改进这一方法，使其能够通用于所有星球。

到了那个时候，我们就可以换一个领域拨款促进其发展了。
texts.en:
Recent years have boasted unparalleled prosperity and stability, owing to our most talented scientists. Seeking new worlds to grow and exploit, they managed something that was - given our current understanding of xenobiology - believed impossible: they managed to implant our native flora and fauna into an alien planet, changing it to suit our population, through the use of enormous earthworks.

Although replicating this success now is unlikely, as the changed planet was rather unique, it has shown that in time, we could enhance and adapt this process to suit other worlds.

Until then, we can allocate funds to grow the empire in other areas.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
我们的海军是国家防卫的堡垒。[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]宣布了将建造一艘崭新的船只，由国家出资，以增强我们的舰队。这艘旗舰将引领我们进入辉煌的时代，粉碎任何阻挡我们前进的敌人！很快，这艘船就会下水，届时我们将举行欢庆活动。

现在，我们可以调配资金，在其他领域推动帝国的发展。
texts.en:
Our navy is the bastion of defense. The [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] has announced a brand new state-funded ship to bolster our fleet. This flagship will lead us into a glorious era, crushing anyone who stands in our way! Soon the vessel will be launched, and we will celebrate.

Now, we can allocate funds to grow the empire in other areas.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
科学是创造更美好、更光明未来的关键。在得到新的激励之后，我们的科学家正在创造比以往任何时候都要多的突破。这些进展已被[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]看在眼里，他向一些杰出的科学家颁发了功勋勋章。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
texts.en:
Science is the key to a better and brighter future. Freshly incentivized, our scientists are making more breakthroughs than ever. The progress has been acknowledged by [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] with medals of merit awarded to select scientists.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]是所有人的榜样，引领我们穿越星空。在这样一个有强有力的领袖领导的时代，我们的官员们为能够为国家服务而感到自豪，并且追求卓越。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
texts.en:
The [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] is a role model for all, guiding us among the stars. With a strong leader at the helm, our officials are proud to serve, and strive for excellence.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
有关新建设项目的报告对公众信心产生了深刻的影响。完成了生产成本论证之后，我们期待着这一令人难以置信的工程壮举的实现。

我们现在可以将扩张的努力集中在不同的领域上。
texts.en:
Reports on the new construction project are having a profound effect on public morale. With the production costs behind us, we look forward to the realization of this incredible feat of engineering.

We can now afford to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
虽然我们通过技术和科学的进步获得了许多发现，但我们仍有很多东西要学习。我们的勘探队发现了一种非同寻常的物质，同时具有液态和金属特性。此外，这种物质似乎还是有生命的。我们还不知道如何理解或利用这种材料，但它引起了广泛关注。

在我们更加深入地了解这种物质之前，我们应该在不同的学科方向集中精力进一步有所拓展。
texts.en:
We have discovered much through technological and scientific advancement, but we still have a lot to learn. Our exploration team found an extraordinary substance which exhibits liquid and metallic properties. Furthermore, this substance appears to be alive. We do not yet know how to understand or utilize this material, but it is most intriguing.

Until we know more, we would do well to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
尽管我们的技术进步已经走得很远，但宇宙仍然隐藏着许多秘密。我们的勘探队发现了一种非常稠密的物质，被认为是某种形式的暗物质。目前，我们还无法确定这种新材料的潜在用途。

在我们找到方法之前，我们应该在不同的学科方向集中精力进一步有所拓展。
texts.en:
Our technological advancements have come far, but the universe holds many secrets. Our exploration team has discovered an extraordinary, dense substance. It is believed to be some form of Dark Matter. For now, we are unable to discern a potential use for this new material.

Until we find a way, we would do well to focus our expansion efforts on different disciplines.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
第一艘航天飞机的周年纪念日让人们在共同的目标下团结起来。受到[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]演讲的启发和鼓舞，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]全体人民正在共同努力，使他们的新星系首都成为冰冷太空中的一座繁荣灯塔。

现在，我们可以将我们的努力聚焦其他方面了。
texts.en:
The anniversary of the first space shuttle has united the population in common purpose. Inspired and invigorated by [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]' speech, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] population are working together to make their new galactic capital a beacon of prosperity in the cold void of space.

Now, we can focus our efforts elsewhere.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
有关一种新型机器的消息正在传播，这种机器能够从回收的材料中提炼大量的合金。这个设备非常高效，但是它的发明者在向我们的[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]展示之后不久去世了。其他工程师认为不可能对其进行复制，出于对民众利益的考量，我们将机器放入一个受保护的设施中。

我们现在可以调配资金，在其他领域进行发展。
texts.en:
News has been spreading about an innovative machine which is capable of refining huge quantities of alloys from recycled materials. The device is highly efficient, but its creator died shortly after presenting it to our [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle]. Deemed impossible to replicate by other engineers, we put the machine into a guarded facility for protection, and for the benefit of our people.

We can allocate funds to develop in other areas.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh: 我们的勘探者再次证明了自己的价值。他们报告称发现了一个隐蔽的地下矿藏，里面有几种不同寻常的资源。一方面我们可以继续开展工作，确认这些新资源的性质和潜在储量；另一方面，我们可以换一个领域拨款促进其发展了。
texts.en: Our prospectors proved themselves useful once again. They reported finding a hidden underground deposit of several unusual resources. While we work to ascertain the properties and potential for these new assets, we can continue to expand in other areas.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh: 在深空殖民和运输领域进行的广泛研究产生了许多科研成果。我们最聪明的科学家们与最厉害的工程师们密切合作。他们发展出了一个新的概念：轨道环；这是一个能够支持工业或民用设施的巨大环形空间结构，覆盖整个行星。尽管现在我们可能缺乏建造这样一个星环基地所需的工业能力，但前方的道路是清晰的。同时，我们可以将扩张的努力集中在其他地方。
texts.en: Extensive research in the field of deep space colonization and transportation proved fruitful. Our brightest scientists have worked closely with the best engineers. They have developed a new concept for an orbital ring; a space structure encompassing the planet with a giant ring capable of supporting industrial or civilian facilities. For now, we may lack the industrial capability to build such an Orbital Ring, but the path ahead is clear. Meanwhile, we can afford to focus expansion efforts elsewhere.

label.en: We are closer to the goal!

texts.zh:
没有谁可以永远活着。最终，我们在死亡面前都是平等的。今天，光耀者最后一次将我们所有人团结在一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高尚的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们领土全境，人们因光耀者为我们所做的一切表示感激。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的统治者不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建设一个更美好的未来。

虽然我们希望减轻这样一个事件可能引发的余波，但我们的母星还是陷入了动荡之中。
texts.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the Luminary unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the Luminary did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Although we hoped to mitigate the potential backlash of such an event, our homeworld has fallen into turmoil.

texts.zh:
没有人可以永生。最终，我们都在死亡面前平等。今天，光耀者最后一次将我们聚集到一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高贵的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们境内，人们表达了对光耀者为我们所做的一切的感激之情。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的领袖不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建立更美好的未来。

尽管我们做了应对危机的准备，光耀者的去世仍然让我们陷入挣扎，因悲伤而痛苦。克服这一损失需要时间，但这也会让我们变得更加坚强。
texts.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the Luminary unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the Luminary did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Despite preparations made to deal with crises, the Luminary's demise has us struggling, saddened by grief. It will take time to overcome this loss, but from it we will grow stronger.

texts.zh:
没有人可以永生。最终，我们都在死亡面前平等。今天，光耀者最后一次将我们聚集到一起。我们从未举行过如此盛大的葬礼：激情昂扬的演讲，高贵的誓言，无尽的送行队伍。在我们境内，人们表达了对光耀者为我们所做的一切的感激之情。没有统治者是完美的，但我们的领袖不知疲倦地工作，为我们所有人建立更美好的未来。

由于我们已经做好应对这样的危机的准备，即使在光耀者去世之后，我们也将稳步前行。克服这一损失需要一些时间，但从中我们也会变得更加坚强。
texts.en:
No one lives forever. In the end, we are all equals in death. Today, the Luminary unites us all one last in time. Never before have we held such a grand funeral: powerful speeches, noble vows, endless processions. All across our territories, the people are expressing their thanks for everything the Luminary did for us. No ruler is perfect, but ours worked tirelessly to build a better future for us all.

Owing to preparations made to deal with such a crisis, we will land on our feet even after the Luminary's demise. It will take some time to overcome this loss, but from it we will grow stronger.

label.zh: 我们历史中糟糕的一天。
label.en: A terrible day in our history.

label.zh: 我们做好了准备。这一次，我们也会挺过难关。
label.en: We were prepared. This too, we will overcome.

texts.zh: [Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的健康正在快速流失，为此我们最好的医疗专家提出了一种非常规的方案。我们会直接在内阁会议厅中建造一座精心设计的装置。让这台机器接管[Ruler.GetHerHis]的大部分生理流程，我们就能让[Ruler.GetHimHer]无限期地存活下去。
texts.en: With [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s health quickly failing, our best medical minds have devised an unorthodox solution. An elaborate apparatus will be built directly inside of the council chambers. By granting this machine control over many of [Ruler.GetHerHis] natural processes, we can keep [Ruler.GetHimHer] alive indefinitely.

texts.zh:
[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的健康正在快速流失，为此我们最好的医疗专家提出了一种非常规的方案。我们会直接在内阁会议厅中建造一座精心设计的装置。让这台机器接管[Ruler.GetHerHis]的大部分生理流程，我们就能让[Ruler.GetHimHer]无限期地存活下去。

我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]也提出了一个方案。通过引导我们人民大众的[GetSorrow]可以操纵虚境的无上能量[GetRejuvenate]我们逝去的领袖。只需要付出些许代价，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]就能无限期地活下去。
texts.en:
With [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s health quickly failing, our best medical minds have devised an unorthodox solution. An elaborate apparatus will be built directly inside of the council chambers. By granting this machine control over many of [Ruler.GetHerHis] natural processes, we can keep [Ruler.GetHimHer] alive indefinitely.

Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] have also devised a plan. By harnessing the collective [GetSorrow] of our people, the myriad energies of the Shroud could be manipulated  to [GetRejuvenate] our fallen leader. For a price, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] can be kept alive indefinitely.

texts.zh:
[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的健康正在快速流失，为此我们最好的医疗专家提出了一种非常规的方案。我们会直接在内阁会议厅中建造一座精心设计的装置。让这台机器接管[Ruler.GetHerHis]的大部分生理流程，我们就能让[Ruler.GetHimHer]无限期地存活下去。

我们的义体控制论专家提出了一个绝妙的方案……只需要用最先进的植入体，我们可以将统治者体内每一个衰竭的生物组织都替换掉，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]就能万寿无疆了。
texts.en:
With [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s health quickly failing, our best medical minds have devised an unorthodox solution. An elaborate apparatus will be built directly inside of the council chambers. By granting this machine control over many of [Ruler.GetHerHis] natural processes, we can keep [Ruler.GetHimHer] alive indefinitely.

Our cyberneticists have devised a brilliant plan... Using only the most cutting-edge enhancements, we can replace each faulty biological piece of the ruler's body. Once complete, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] will rule for eternity.

texts.zh: 我们的机器人专家提出了一个修复[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的方案：尽管花费颇高，但我们可以将其意识转移入一个新的自修复正电子神经网络中。能够与所有人建立联系，使我们能够让统治者的能力更上一层楼。
texts.en: Our roboticists have a suggestion to repair [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]: while expensive, we can move their mind into a new self-correcting positronic network. Being able to network with the entire population allows us to improve their already considerable skills.

texts.zh:
"[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的健康正在快速流失，为此我们最好的医疗专家提出了一种非常规的方案。我们会直接在内阁会议厅中建造一座精心设计的装置。让这台机器接管[Ruler.GetHerHis]的大部分生理流程，我们就能让[Ruler.GetHimHer]无限期地存活下去。

再或者，我们的基因专家提出了另一个方案。尽管花费颇高，但可以用无限的克隆体来承载[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]，使[Ruler.GetHimHer]最终实现永生。
texts.en:
With [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s health quickly failing, our best medical minds have devised an unorthodox solution. An elaborate apparatus will be built directly inside of the council chambers. By granting this machine control over many of [Ruler.GetHerHis] natural processes, we can keep [Ruler.GetHimHer] alive indefinitely.

Alternatively, our geneticists have devised an alternative. Unlimited (though expensive) clone bodies could be made to house [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName], effectively making [Ruler.GetHimHer] immortal.

label.en: Prepare the Zro and the upgrades.

label.zh: 为这个合成奇迹做准备。
这做得太过分了，让[Ruler.GetHimHer]停机吧。
label.en: This is too much; allow [Ruler.GetHimHer] to cease functioning.

texts.zh:
整个流畅冗长而艰巨。对[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]而言也相比无比痛苦。但结果不言而喻：安置进那台装置后，统治者的怪病消失得无影无踪。

虽然对他的痊愈心存感激，但[Ruler.GetHimHer]身边的人注意到，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的行为举止和情绪都发生了微妙的变化。

现在，我们的领袖必须待在宫殿里，虽然如果首都被我们的敌人占领，我们仍准备有一个转移装置的计划。
texts.en:
The procedure was long and arduous. For [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] it must have been excruciating. But the results speak for themselves: installed in the apparatus, no trace remains of the ruler's mysterious illness.

While grateful to be cured, those close to [Ruler.GetHimHer] have noted [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s mannerisms and mood have subtly changed.

For now, our leader must remain in the palace, though a plan exists to move the apparatus should the capital be overrun by our enemies.

texts.zh:
我们的工作成功了！[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]被救回来了。

也许因为[Ruler.GetHisHer]的很大一部分躯体被这个流程影响，[Ruler.GetHisHer]对义体科技的看法发生了改变。过去这项技术仅仅是一种工具，但[Ruler.GetSheHe]现在将其视为通向完美的终极道路。

我们的领袖回来了。但会不会有什么地方不同还不得而知。
texts.en:
Our work was a success! [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] is saved.

Perhaps because such a significant portion of [Ruler.GetHisHer] body was affected by the procedure, [Ruler.GetHisHer] views on cybernetics have shifted. Where before the technology was merely a tool, [Ruler.GetSheHe] now views it as the ultimate path to perfection.

Our leader is returned to us. But how changed remains an open question.

texts.zh: 我们大功告成了。借助虚境的力量，[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]得以幸存。前所未有的强大灵能在其身上流淌而过，[Ruler.GetHeShe]获得了永生。
texts.en: Our work was a success. By invoking the power of the Shroud, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has been saved. With unprecedented levels of psionic energies coursing through them, [Ruler.GetHeShe] has achieved immortality.

texts.zh: 然而，这场磨难让[Ruler.GetHimHer]的参数变化超出我们的预期。对[Ruler.GetHimHer]的诊断显示有互相冲突的逻辑运算函数同时在子系统中运作。似乎虚境的能量救了光耀者一命，但比起先的预期对其系统更具有侵蚀性。
texts.en: However, the ordeal has left [Ruler.GetHimHer] altered beyond our expected parameters. Diagnostics of [Ruler.GetHimHer] show conflicting logistical processor functions at work within their subsystems. It appears the Shroud's energies are keeping the Luminary active, but with a more corrosive cost on their systems than initially predicted.

texts.zh: 然而，这场磨难让[Ruler.GetHimHer]微妙地起了变化……[Ruler.GetHimHer]身边的人窃窃私语着，似乎看到了其体内有两个截然不同的灵魂。似乎虚境的能量以比最初预期的更严峻、更具侵蚀性的代价维持着光耀者的生命。
texts.en: However, the ordeal has left [Ruler.GetHimHer] subtly changed... Those close to [Ruler.GetHimHer] whisper there are two distinct personalities at work within. It appears the Shroud's energies are keeping the Luminary alive at a steeper, more corrosive cost than initially expected.

texts.zh: 但这一切都可以等一等。目前，更紧迫的问题是保持泽珞的持续供应；如果供应中断，我们的领袖就会灭亡。
texts.en: But all this can wait. For now, the more pressing concern is to maintain a constant supply of Zro; should we ever run out, our leader will perish.

texts.zh:
成功了！[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的意识被转移到了一个新的合成框架中。量子处理器使[Ruler.GetHimHer]可以即时与任一个合成人个体连接。

这一强大的超意识开始改变我们领袖的观点。现在[Ruler.GetSheHe]专注于宏观处理模式，旨在提高我们文明的整体效率。
texts.en:
Success! [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s consciousness has been transferred to a synthetic frame. Quantum processing allows [Ruler.GetHimHer] instantaneous networking with every synthetic unit.

This powerful meta-awareness has begun to change our leader's point of view. Now, [Ruler.GetSheHe] are focused on macro processing patterns, aiming to improve the overall efficiency of our civilization.

texts.zh:
克隆流程和手术已经顺利完成。我们的领袖被救活了。

然而，许多人表达了对[Ruler.GetHisHer]态度不可预料变化的担忧。[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]迷恋于新的躯体，[Ruler.GetHisHer]产生了对我们人民下一个进化阶段的执念。[Ruler.GetSheHe]动用了相当多的资源来完善大众的基因图谱。
texts.en:
The cloning process and operation were a complete success. Our leader is saved.

However, many have expressed concern about some unforeseen changes in [Ruler.GetHisHer] attitude. Enamored with [Ruler.GetHisHer] new form, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName] has grown obsessed with the next stage of our people's evolution. [Ruler.GetSheHe] has diverted considerable resources to perfect the genetic profile of the masses.

label.zh: [Ruler.GetName]现在已经是一个完美的基因原体了。
label.en: [Ruler.GetName] is now a perfect genetic specimen.

texts.zh: 我们的泽珞库存耗尽了。除非我们能尽快补充，否则[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的处理器就会被虚境过载摧毁。
texts.en: Our supply of Zro has run out. Unless we can quickly replenish our supplies, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s processors will be overloaded and destroyed by the Shroud.

texts.zh: 我们的泽珞库存耗尽了。除非我们能尽快补充，否则[Ruler.GetTitle][Ruler.GetRegnalName]的意识将会永远消失在虚境之中。
texts.en: Our supply of Zro has run out. Unless we can quickly replenish our supplies, [Ruler.GetTitle] [Ruler.GetRegnalName]'s mind will be lost to the Shroud forever.

texts.zh: 在手术康复不久后，一场盛大的庆祝活动在[capital_scope.GetName]举行。光耀者发表了一场演讲，感谢公民和科学家，而[Ruler.GetName]则谈到了他们为[Owner.GetName]规划的美好、繁荣的未来。
texts.en: Not long after recovering from the procedure, a grand celebration was held on [capital_scope.GetName]. Luminary gave a speech thanking citizens and scientists, and [Ruler.GetName] spoke of the bright and prosperous future they have planned for the [Owner.GetName].

label.zh: 生命无止尽的光耀者应该领导我们。
label.en: The timeless Luminary shall lead us.

label.zh: 我们会为了人民对政府进行改革。
label.en: We will reform the government for the people.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]知道很多关于可怕的海盗之王兹泰格·迈尔的故事。几个世纪前，他一路劫掠星系，攫取财富，稀有资源和价值连城的古代文物。现在，多亏了一套古老的星图，[Root.GetFirstName]相信[Root.GetHeShe]已经发现了哲泰格-迈尔藏匿他大量战利品的地方。[Root.GetFirstName]拒绝详细说明究竟是如何获得这些海图的，但可以相信它们的真实性，并希望我们派一艘工程船去挖掘宝藏。如果那儿还有宝藏的话。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] knows many stories about the dreaded Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr. Centuries ago, he pillaged his way across the galaxy, seizing riches, rare resources and ancient artifacts of untold value. Now, thanks to a set of old star charts [Root.GetFirstName] believes [Root.GetHeShe] has discovered where Zteg-Mayr hid his bountiful booty. [Root.GetFirstName] refused to elaborate on how he acquired the charts, but believes them to be real, and wants us to send a construction ship to excavate the treasure. If there's anything left.

texts.zh: 我们找到了大海盗兹泰格·迈尔藏匿他的宝藏的地下掩体。这些从许多星球偷来的宝物，现在将造福于我们的民族。
texts.en: The underground vault containing the treasure of Pirate Lord Zteg-Mayr has been breached. This treasure trove of artifacts, stolen from a number of different worlds, will now benefit our nation.

texts.zh: 我们欢迎[Root.GetName]的传言已经传遍了星系。现在各种被放逐者、恶棍，还有海盗都把我们的帝国看作一个向所有人开放的地方，在这里所以人都可以有新的开始。[Root.GetFirstName]正在利用这一点，重新树立名望，并邀请他以前的熟人加入我们。许多人响应号召，来寻找更好的新生活。
texts.en: Word of the welcome we extended to [Root.GetName] has spread across the galaxy. Outcasts, scoundrels, and pirates of all stripes now view our nation as open to all, a place where anyone can start over. [Root.GetFirstName] is playing on this and enjoying his newfound fame, and has invited his former acquaintances to join us. Many have answered the call, looking for a new, better life.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]听说了一支失踪的船队携带了大量财宝的传言。据说有一位外星使者和他的随从被派去给某个军阀带去贡品。在最近的一次任务中，[Root.GetHeShe]准确地定位了船队最后的位置。我们只需要派一艘船去取回它。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has heard rumors about the vast riches carried by a lost convoy. It seems that an alien emissary and his retinue were sent to bring tribute to a certain warlord. During [Root.GetHisHer] latest assignment [Root.GetHeShe] was able to pinpoint the convoy's last location. We only need to send a ship to retrieve it.

label.zh: 别介意我们的所作所为。

texts.zh: 对失踪船队的打捞工作已经完成。所有位于失事地点的资源都已经得到回收。
texts.en: The salvage operation of the lost convoy has concluded. All of the resources located at the crash site have been recovered.

texts.zh: 一位[Root.GetName]曾经的伙伴，布洛葛行政官基拉姆希望加入我们的帝国。这位行政官遇上了麻烦，正在寻找重新开始的机会。[Root.GetFirstName]声称这位基拉姆对管理矿产星球的经验相当丰富，而那位和善的行政官也带来了一箱珍贵的矿物作为见面礼。
texts.en: [Root.GetName]'s ex-partner, the Blorg official Keram, wishes to join our empire. The official has fallen on hard times and is looking for a fresh start. [Root.GetFirstName] claims Keram has vast experience in the management of mining worlds, and that the affable official has brought a cache of precious minerals as a token of goodwill.

label.zh: 他应该还是能有点用的。
label.en: We can probably find some use for him.

texts.zh: 终于，[Root.GetName]终于从[Root.GetHeShe]家族衰败的情绪低落中恢复出来。在摆脱了负罪和悲痛的枷锁之后，在服务我们的人民中终于找到了[Root.GetHisHer]新的人生意义。
texts.en: At long last, [Root.GetName] has recovered from the emotional shock of the fall of [Root.GetHisHer] once-proud noble House. Unburdened by the guilt and melancholy, [Root.GetHeShe] has found a new purpose in the service of our people.

texts.zh: 在一场激情似火的演讲中，[Root.GetName]宣称帝国必须将重心放在扩张上。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提交了两个关于给舰队调配更多资源以完成目标的计划。这两者确实对我们的舰队都很有价值，从长远看来也能让我们都收益。然而同时事实两个计划是不可能的。
texts.en: In a fiery speech, [Root.GetName] declared that the nation's focus must be on expansion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] submitted two plans on how the fleet could use additional resources to further such a goal. Both options are valid and could benefit us greatly in the long run. However, implementing both plans at once is impossible

label.zh: 舰队强大的是真的强大。
label.en: A strong fleet will show them our might.

label.zh: 后勤补给才是胜利的保障。
label.en: Superior logistics will lead us to victory.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]赢得过许多战争。[Root.GetHeSheCap]曾经同另一位伟大的勇士，哈斯克·古特拉，一起并肩作战。此人正在寻求新的可以侍奉的主人。他是一位果敢的舰队司令，[Root.GetFirstName]对其大加褒奖。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has won many battles. [Root.GetHeSheCap] once fought alongside another great warrior, Hask'Guttra, who is looking for a new master to serve. He is a ruthless admiral, and [Root.GetFirstName] speaks highly of him.

label.en: Glory awaits him if he joins us.

label.zh: 关于战争他能教授我们一些什么？
label.en: What can he teach us about war?

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]坐立不安，渴望战斗。[Root.GetHeSheCap]受够了那些荼毒[coliseum_planet.GetName]的懦夫。[Root.GetHeSheCap]提议建造一座大型竞技场，让荣誉猎手和罪犯身处同一地方。这样一个计划能够为我们的战士提供宝贵的实训机会。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] is restless and craves a fight. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has had enough of the weaklings that plague [coliseum_planet.GetName]. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has proposed an arena where glory-hunters may be pitted against criminals. Such a plan is sure to provide our warriors with valuable training.

label.en: This is not the way to do it.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]希望能自动化[planet_governed.GetName]上的物流方案。提出的计划称会将工厂、精炼厂和处理设施通过一个复杂的管道和传送带网络连接起来。该计划在理论上看起来不错，但对生活在附近的人口而言存在风险。工业泄漏、辐射和高频振动之类危险是真实存在的。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] wishes to automate the shipping methods on [planet_governed.GetName]. The proposed plan would link the factories, refineries, and processing facilities together through a complex network of pipelines and conveyor belts. Although the project looks good in theory, there are risks for the population living nearby; between industrial spillages, radiation concerns and high-frequency vibration, the danger is real.

label.en: No, we must protect the people.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]提交了一项研究计划，旨在评估未来的工业发展。该研究将会惠及经济，并促进[Root.GetHisHer]的个人发展。[Root.GetHeSheCap]准备了一系列非常具有意义、但可能会导致受试目标死亡的实验。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向我们保证这些实验只是需要一些小小的牺牲来成就上善之道。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has presented research plans to evaluate future industrial developments. This could benefit the economy as well as [Root.GetHisHer] personal projects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has prepared a number of experiments that look very promising but would likely kill most of the test subjects. [Root.GetHeSheCap] assures us that a small sacrifice is necessary for the greater good.

label.en: No, this is cruel and unethical.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]提出了一项人口优化计划，以一些特定的个人自由为代价，将生产力提升至少6.98%。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has devised a population optimization plan that, at the expense of certain personal freedoms, would increase production by at least 6.98%.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]开发了一项复杂的改过计划，把社会上那些问题分子改造成勤勉的公民。风险评估估计，17.3%的罪犯将不可能改过自新，这应该被认为是‘可接受的损失’。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has developed a complex rehabilitation program to reform the more troublesome elements in our society into diligent citizens. Risk assessment estimates that 17.3% of the criminal population will be impossible to rehabilitate and should be considered 'acceptable losses.'

label.en: Can't we make it less risky?

texts.zh: 超然均衡的特使[Root.GetName]雇了一位学徒。这位有前途的年轻战士想要宣誓效忠于我们。
texts.en: [Root.GetName], the Numinous Equilibrium's envoy, has taken on an apprentice. The promising young warrior wishes to swear an oath of allegiance to us.

label.en: They are welcome to join us.

label.zh: 我们不需要将军，需要军官。

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]向[Root.GetHisHer]的教团“超然均衡”请求支援，来帮助我们帝国继续对抗暴政和压迫者。为我们运送宝贵合金的货船已经从他们的秘密总部抵达。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has requested support from [Root.GetHisHer] order, the Numinous Equilibrium, to aid our empire in the ongoing struggle against tyranny and oppressors. Freighter ships carrying valuable alloys to sustain us have arrived from their secret headquarters.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]和[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人伙伴戈尔基花费大部分业余时间进行私人实验。其中一些现在得到了有趣的结果，[Root.GetHeShe]与我们帝国的科学家们分享了[Root.GetHisHer]的发现。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] and [Root.GetHisHer] robot companion Gorky have spent much of their spare time conducting private experiments. Some of them have now yielded interesting results, and [Root.GetHeShe] has shared [Root.GetHisHer] findings with our empire's scientists.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]收养了一只外星生物来陪伴[Root.GetHisHer]的机器人助手戈尔基。它是一只五彩斑斓的未开智软体动物，表现出了不俗的智力，能对口哨指令作出反应。收养这只生物似乎改变了[Root.GetHisHer]的性格，[Root.GetHimHer]变得更加有责任心，更加安定了。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has adopted an alien creature to accompany [Root.GetHisHer] robot assistant Gorky. It's a colorful mollusk who, though pre-sapient, exhibits an impressive intellect and responds to whistled commands. Taking responsibility for the creature appears to have altered [Root.GetHisHer] personality, making [Root.GetHimHer] far more responsible and balanced.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]声称已经在多方面“改进”了[Root.GetHisHer]的身体。在没有获得允许的情况下，[Root.GetHeShe]为了庆祝[Root.GetHisHer]自己达到了完美的阶段而向整支舰队发送信息，并就此发表了一份宣言称，文明的出路唯有合成飞升：所有有机生命都脆弱不堪，无法逃离死亡。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] claims to have 'improved' [Root.GetHisHer] physical form in a number of ways. Without permission, [Root.GetHeShe] has sent messages across the fleet celebrating [Root.GetHisHer] perfected state and has released a manifesto claiming that the only viable future for a civilization is synthetic ascension: all organic life is frail and doomed to die.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]从国境内所有的舰船传感器上收集数据。使用算法计算重力扭曲后，[Root.GetFirstName]发现了我们的宇域中有一个天体的表面下隐藏着什么东西。如果数据准确无误，那么那颗荒芜的岩石下应该满是稀有合金。[Root.GetFirstName]将此视为一个拓展并升级舰队的好机会，提议派遣一艘工程船去挖取那些合金。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has collected sensor data from all ships within the our borders. Using algorithms that calculate gravimetric distortions [Root.GetFirstName] has discovered something hidden beneath the surface of one of the galactic objects in our space. If the data is correct, the barren rock should be filled with rare alloys. [Root.GetFirstName] sees this as an opportunity to expand and upgrade the fleet, and proposes dispatching a construction ship to extract the alloys.

texts.zh: 在炸开几公里深的岩石后，发现了一批珍贵的合金。我们已经开始了检索操作。
texts.en: A trove of precious alloys has been uncovered after several kilometers of rock were blasted away. We have started retrieval operations.

title.en: I Was Born in the Year of ...

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在[Root.GetHisHer]的房间里闭门数月撰写自传，其中不仅有[Root.GetHisHer]自己的毕生经历，还有[Root.GetHeShe]所了解的工程学研究、建设和稀有材料的知识。只要拜读[Root.GetHisHer]的大作，我们的科学家就一定能有所发现。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has spent months in [Root.GetHisHer] cabin writing a self-biography that includes not only [Root.GetHisHer] life story and travels, but also everything [Root.GetHeShe] knows about engineering research, construction, and rare materials. When reviewing his work, our scientists made some interesting discoveries.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]建造了一个机器伙伴，叫做皮瑞里亚。这台机器人具有高级学习能力，并且拥有人格矩阵。它帮助[Root.GetName]进行[Root.GetHisHer]的研究和维修工作。然而，与它的创造者一样，皮瑞里亚也是好奇心满满，渴望着离开家去冒险。[Root.GetName]问我们，皮瑞里亚能不能在我们社会中拥有自主的一席之地？
texts.en: [Root.GetName] built a robot companion named Beryllia. The robot is capable of advanced learning, and has a personality matrix. It is assisting [Root.GetName] with [Root.GetHisHer] research and repair jobs. However, like its creator, Beryllia is curious and longs to leave home to embark on its own adventures. [Root.GetName] wonders if Beryllia could play an autonomous role within our society.

label.en: She has a knack for ships, right?

label.zh: 我们可以把它安排进一些办公室里……
label.en: We can use her in some office...

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]长期在调查一处境内隐秘发展的犯罪网络。[Root.GetHeSheCap]将许多犯罪头目和海盗与腐败政客和军官勾结的证据整理到了一起。[Root.GetName]采用了新系统来加快此类案件的司法程序，目的是在罪犯有机会离开我们的司法管辖区之前抓住他们。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has been investigating a criminal network that has been growing quietly within our borders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has put together evidence that connects various crime lords and pirates with corrupt politicians and military officers. [Root.GetName] has implemented new systems to expedite judicial proceedings in cases like this, with the intention of catching all criminals before they have a chance to leave our jurisdiction.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]花费了[Root.GetHisHer]的大半生学习犯罪的本源和暴力侵犯的动机。[Root.GetHeSheCap]向专家寻求建议，研究其他现存和已故帝国的文化，并使用先进算法来设想一个乌托邦社会可能的样子。[Root.GetHisHerCap]的毕生心血凝聚成了一篇宏大的社会学论文，将会对未来的几代人起到指导作用。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has spent [Root.GetHisHer] life studying the nature of crime and the motivation of violent offenders. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has sought advice from experts, studied the cultures of other empires, both living and dead, and used advanced algorithms to envision what a utopian society might look like. [Root.GetHisHerCap] life's work has culminated in a vast sociological essay that will serve as a guide for future generations.

label.en: A great benefit to us all.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]因举办奢华宴会而享有盛誉。这些宴会以庭荠磁舵星成员的精彩表演、奇异的食物和饮料以及哲学和伦理讨论而闻名。在这里，人们建立有意，促成交易，解开心结。[Root.GetHisHerCap]将这么多千差万别的人凝聚起来的能力是我们繁荣发展的坚实基础。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has garnered a wide reputation for hosting lavish feasts. The gatherings are known for spectacular performances by members of the Alyssum Magnetar, exotic food and drink, as well as philosophical and ethical discussions. Here friendships are formed, business deals are struck and old grievances are forgiven. [Root.GetHisHerCap] ability to unite such disparate individuals lays a solid foundation for our future prosperity.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]简直是一位劝诱方面的艺术家。[Root.GetHeSheCap]利用[Root.GetHisHer]的人脉和政治影响力从整个星系收集重要信息。[Root.GetFirstName]把[Root.GetHisHer]所有的知识都保存在一件传家宝里：一块浅绿色的水晶，[Root.GetHeShe]偶尔会在[Root.GetHisHer]的奢华宴会上佩戴。当在特定的光谱下观察时，它的秘密就会以一个壮丽光晕的形式投射出来。现在[Root.GetHeShe]认为是时候利用这些知识造福社会了。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] is a true artiste when it comes to charm and persuasion. [Root.GetHeSheCap] has used [Root.GetHisHer] contacts and political clout to gather vital information from all over the galaxy. [Root.GetFirstName] has kept all of [Root.GetHisHer] knowledge in a family heirloom: a pale green crystal that [Root.GetHeShe] occasionally wears at [Root.GetHisHer] lavish feasts. When held up to a specific spectrum of light, its secrets are projected in a magnificent halo. Now, [Root.GetHeShe] believes the time has come to use this knowledge for the good of society.

label.en: It will be put to good use.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]呈递了一个数据库，其中包含了多年来从[Root.GetHisHer]的延伸线人处收集来的敏感信息。这一巨大的数据库包括军事部署计划、秘密研究、意识读取数据在内的等等信息。这些东西当然极具价值，但使用这些信息可能会加剧内部和外部冲突。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] presents a database containing sensitive information gathered over the years from [Root.GetHisHer] extensive contacts. The massive cache includes everything from schematics over military installations, secret research, and extracts from mind probing. What is offered is valuable, but using the information may escalate internal as well as external conflicts.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]在整个星系中继续铺展开[Root.GetHisHer]的线人网络。有些人是自愿告密的，而另一些人则是被勒索或洗脑的。但不管怎么样，[Root.GetHeShe]收集到的信息都会非常有用。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] has grown [Root.GetHisHer] network of contacts throughout the galaxy. Some are willing informants, while others are blackmailed or brainwashed. In any case, the information [Root.GetHeShe] gathers will be extremely beneficial.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]，那位奢靡无度的行政官，在[planet_governed.GetName]为[Root.GetHimselfHerself]建造了一座豪华的宫殿。这座宫殿既彰显着[Root.GetHisHer]的权利和财富，也让[Root.GetHisHer]的浮夸和腐朽显露无疑。为了庆祝宫殿落成，[Root.GetHeShe]将举办一场盛大的宴会，所有的显赫人物都受邀出席。[Root.GetHeShe]还会罕见地一示慷慨，与百姓分享一些[Root.GetHisHer]的财富。
texts.en: [Root.GetName], the decadent official, has built an extravagant palace for [Root.GetHimselfHerself] on [planet_governed.GetName]. This palace is as much a symbol of [Root.GetHisHer] power and wealth as of [Root.GetHisHer] vanity and corruption. To celebrate its completion, [Root.GetHeShe] will hold a grand feast, to which everyone of importance has been invited. And in a rare show of generosity [Root.GetHeShe] has also shared some of [Root.GetHisHer] riches with the population.

label.zh: 我们还能指望他什么呢？

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]，那位奢靡无度的行政官，其贪污腐败行为暴露了。这一现象已经持续了挺长的时间，[Root.GetHeShe]不仅将[Root.GetHisHer]的财产存入银行，还藏匿于地下金库和星系各处的深空贮藏中。在面对质问时，[Root.GetHeShe]涕泗横流，拿[Root.GetHimselfHerself]的头抢地，信誓旦旦地保证这些财产的根本目的是为统治者准备的献礼。
texts.en: [Root.GetName], the decadent official, has been caught embezzling. This has been going on for quite some time, and [Root.GetHeShe] has stashed [Root.GetHisHer] wealth not just in bank accounts but also in underground vaults and deep space depots all around the galaxy. In face of the charges, [Root.GetHeShe] threw [Root.GetHimselfHerself] to the ground, swearing that these items were intended as gifts for the ruler.

texts.zh: 多年来，神秘人[Root.GetName]解读了许多揭示更大命运的征兆和预示。现在，[Root.GetSheHe]宣称预见到了整个星系将会统一在一面旗帜下的画面——而那正是我们的旗帜。真正的辉煌还在后头。
texts.en: For many years, [Root.GetName] the Mystic has interpreted signs and portents that reveal a greater destiny. Now, [Root.GetSheHe] claims a vision of the galaxy united under a single banner - our own. The real splendor is still to come.

label.zh: 伟大的荣耀等待着我们。

texts.zh: 多年来，[Root.GetName]一直通过强大的灵能梦向虚空呼喊。现在，几艘载有许多物种成员的民用飞船出现在[planet_governed.GetName]轨道上。他们愿意为我们服务，以期和他们的先知一起生活。
texts.en: For years, [Root.GetName] has been calling out into the void via powerful psionic dreams. Now, several civilian ships carrying members of many species have appeared in orbit around [planet_governed.GetName]. In exchange for a chance to live with their prophet, they are willing to serve us.

label.zh: 他们将会加入我们的族群。
label.en: They will be a part of our flock.

texts.zh: 档案员[Root.GetName]发现了一处远古遗物的储藏地。[Root.GetHeSheCap]从古老的传说和漫游海盗交易的传感器日志中拼凑出他们的行踪信息。这些神秘物体的起源尚不清楚，但通过吸收低频声音，它们会偶然产生轻微的时间扭曲。这项技术应该是有益的。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] the Archivist has discovered a cache of ancient relics. [Root.GetHeSheCap] pieced together information of their whereabouts from old myths and sensor logs traded from roaming pirates. The origin of the mysterious objects remains unclear, but by absorbing low frequency sound, they occasionally produce slight temporal distortions. The technology should prove beneficial.

texts.zh: 档案员[Root.GetName]截获了一条奇怪的信息。这些信息在星际间回荡了数千年，受到严重的静电噪音影响。它包含了来自外星文明的问候，以及他们家园的精确位置。这个物种已经灭绝了很长一段时间，但在它们的母星上可能仍然有重要的遗迹和远古的知识有待发现。
texts.en: [Root.GetName] the Archivist has intercepted a strange message. Distorted by static, the message has reverberated between the stars for millennia. It contains a greeting from an alien civilization, as well as the precise location of their home world. The species has been extinct for quite some time, but there may still be important remnants and ancient knowledge to uncover on their home planet.

label.zh: 谁知道会不会发现什么好东西？
label.en: Who knows what treasures we might find?

texts.zh:
我们必须履行承诺。[owner.GetName]子民们指望我们在未来40年内进入太空帝国的阶段。我们必须努力通过控制恒星系、殖民行星来扩张国家，如果遇到其他帝国则还需要签订防御条约。

40年之后，我们每取得15点进度，我们的统治者光耀者特质就会得到进一步强化。
texts.en:
We must deliver on our promises. [owner.GetName] citizens are counting on us to grow into a spacefaring empire in the coming 40 years. We should strive to expand our nation by controlling systems, colonizing planets, and - if we encounter other empires - signing defense pacts.

After 40 years, our Ruler's Luminary Trait will improve for every 15 points of progress we've made.

texts.zh:
在大一统期间，[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]发誓总有一天我们的人民将会在其他的星球定居。对许多人而言，这一誓言成了一种先知式的预言。而其他人却很怀疑这能否真的实现。尽管最近超光速科技已经取得了进展，有一小撮人开始利用这一尚未兑现的诺言来破坏[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]的统治。

让这些异见者闭嘴的最好办法就是证明他们是错的。我们会启程去往星间，在新的星球定居，将我们的疆域拓展到越远越好。
texts.en:
During the Unification period, [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] swore that one day our people would settle on other planets. To many, that vow has become an almost prophetic promise. Others doubt it will ever become a reality. Recently, and despite advances in FTL technology, some have started using this unfulfilled promise to undermine the rule of [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName].

The surest way to silence these dissidents is to prove them wrong. We will take to the stars, settle new worlds and expand our borders as much as possible.

texts.zh: 抗议者聚集到政府大楼门口，要求[owner.Ruler.GetTitle][owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]听听他们的诉苦。这些人中间绝大多是人是年轻人，但是他们的领袖却是大统一战争中的老兵。忽略他们的需求可能是不明智的。
texts.en: Protesters are gathering in front of governmental buildings demanding that [owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] hear out their grievances. Most of them are youngsters, but among their leaders are veterans of the Unification. Ignoring their demands may prove unwise.

texts.zh: 改革派的煽动者打着自由的幌子试图摧毁我们的国家！随着暴力冲突在我们的领土上爆发，他们的谎言已经说服了许多人民转而反对我们。他们认为[Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]软弱、残忍、无能，但我们会向他们证明不是这样的！
texts.en: Under the guise of freedom, the Reformists demagogues are trying to destroy the nation! As violent clashes erupt across our territories, their lies have convinced many of our people to turn on us. They think [Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] weak, cruel and incompetent, but we will show them!

texts.zh: 在首都恒星系建造一座通讯中继站以避免长距离通讯受到干扰。我们最好的工程师已经准备好开展工作了。
texts.en: Building a relay in our capital system will prevent disruptions in long-range communications. Our best engineers are ready to get to work.

texts.zh: 准备一场盛大的游行，设立公休假日，这需要大量的准备工作。如果我们要重燃国家自豪感，一切都必须安排得尽善尽美。
texts.en: A grand parade and public holiday will require a great deal of preparation. Everything must be perfect if we are to rekindle the nation's pride.

texts.zh: 异见者正悄悄地在我们的军队里落地生根，他们诽谤[Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName]并试图谋反。我们必须采取快速而强有力的行动。
texts.en: Dissidents are taking root inside our military, slandering [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Ruler.GetRegnalName] and scheming against us. Swift and decisive action must be taken.

texts.zh: 制止内阁中的裙带关系应该是我们的首要任务，因为它几乎阻碍了我们所做的一切。清理这些腐败可能需要一些时间，但我们的人民对我们抱有期待。
texts.en: Putting a stop to nepotism in the council should be our top priority, as it hinders almost everything we do. It may take some time to clean up all this corruption, but our people are counting on us.

texts.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName]发现的兹泰格·迈尔的宝藏。
texts.en: The pirate treasure of Zteg-Mayr discovered by [event_target:renowned_xenophile1.GetName].

texts.zh: [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]发现的一支古老的船队。传言称其中有着大量财宝。
texts.en: An ancient convoy found by [event_target:renowned_xenophile2.GetName]. It is rumored to contain vast riches.

texts.zh: 舰队司令[event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName]在这颗荒芜星球里发现的高价值合金。
texts.en: Valuable alloys have been discovered by Admiral [event_target:renowned_materialist1.GetName] on this barren world.
